# JSON output

One page per output shape, generated from the JSON Schemas in `docs/schema/`, which are generated from the code. Every command wraps its output in the same [envelope](envelope.md); [Reading the JSON output](../../getting-started/reading-json.md) explains it. Ignore fields you do not know: new fields can appear in any release, and `schema_version` changes only when a field is renamed, removed or retyped.

| payload | produced by | root type |
